name: brmodelo-r
description: Ferramenta de modelagem de banco de dados

scripts.pkg:server: npm run build:client && npm run build:server-backend && pkg dist/server.cjs --targets node18-linux-x64,node18-macos-x64,node18-win-x64,node18-linux-arm64 --out-path release-server
scripts.electron:build:client:win: npm run build:client && electron-builder build --config electron-builder-client.json --win portable --x64 --ia32 --arm64
scripts.electron:build:client:linux: npm run build:client && electron-builder build --config electron-builder-client.json --linux deb --x64 --arm64
scripts.electron:build:client:mac: npm run build:client && electron-builder build --config electron-builder-client.json --mac dmg
scripts.electron:build:server:win: npm run build:server-app && electron-builder build --config electron-builder-server.json --win portable --x64 --ia32 --arm64
scripts.electron:build:server:linux: npm run build:server-app && electron-builder build --config electron-builder-server.json --linux deb --x64 --arm64
scripts.electron:build:server:mac: npm run build:server-app && electron-builder build --config electron-builder-server.json --mac dmg
scripts.cap:build: npm run build:client && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:build:android: npm run build:client && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleClientRelease assembleServerRelease
scripts.cap:build:ios: npm run build:client && npx cap sync ios
